reason_text.line_err_rel: an invoice line total does not match qty x unit price
reason_text.grand_err_rel: invoice grand total does not match the sum of its lines
reason_text.eta_minus_ship: delivery ETA is not after the ship-on-board date ({v:.0f} days)
reason_text.inv_minus_ship: invoice is dated after the goods were shipped ({v:.0f} days)
reason_text.po_minus_inv: purchase order is dated after the invoice ({v:.0f} days)
reason_text.qty_mismatch_pl: {v:.0f} item quantity(ies) differ between invoice and packing list
reason_text.qty_mismatch_po: {v:.0f} item quantity(ies) differ between invoice and purchase order
reason_text.consignee_match: bill of lading consignee does not match the invoice buyer
reason_text.weight_diff_rel: bill of lading weight differs from packing list weight ({v:.0%})
reason_text.weight_ratio_expected: declared gross weight is far from the expected weight of the goods (ratio {v:.2f})
reason_text.qty_vs_seller_mean: order quantity is x{v:.1f} of this seller's usual order
reason_text.invoice_seen_before: this invoice number was already used in an earlier shipment
reason_text.seller_known: seller is not a registered seller
reason_text.seller_prev_count: seller has little or no shipment history
reason_text.amount_vs_seller_mean: order value is unusual for this seller (x{v:.1f} of usual)
reason_text.price_ratio_min: a unit price is far below the normal price (ratio {v:.2f})
reason_text.price_ratio_max: a unit price is far above the normal price (ratio {v:.2f})
reason_text.hs_valid_all: an HS code is not valid
reason_text.r_seller_hs: rule: unregistered seller or invalid HS code
